template.banner: This is a generic notice shipped with the software. {legalName} has not published its own version of this document; write to {supportEmail} for the binding terms.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: {legalName} runs this service at {publicUrl} with {productName}, self-hosted restaurant software.
We process the data you enter (account details, orders, payments, reservations and messages) only to provide the service of the restaurant you interact with.
Payment, messaging and email providers enabled by the operator process data under their own terms.
To access, correct or delete your data, write to {supportEmail}.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: By using this service you agree to use it lawfully and not to disrupt it or other users.
{legalName} provides the service as is, to the extent the law allows.
Orders, prices and payments are agreed between you and the restaurant that serves you.

refund.title: Refunds
body: Refunds for orders and payments are handled by the restaurant that charged you, under its own policy and the law that applies to it.
Contact the restaurant directly, or write to {supportEmail} if you cannot reach it.
